root_cause: Stale test-helper contract: commit 26d1606 made add.tsx router.replace a non-blocked already_exists re-add to /contacts?id=<hex>&exists=1 (contacts.tsx renders contact-already-exists-info). seedContact still waited for contact-added-success OR add-page-error, so the second seed of the same contact timed out.
fix: seedContact now waits for contact-added-success OR contact-already-exists-info, then asserts URL matches /contacts/?\?id=<expectedHex>&(added|exists)=1(&|$). add-page-error no longer accepted (blocked/self/invalid must fail loudly). Doc comment rewritten.
tests_added: none - the three existing failing specs are the reproduction

baseline.lint: not configured (next lint prompts interactively; no eslint config) - not runnable
baseline.e2e_3_specs: 16 tests: 3 failed, 2 did not run, 11 passed

verification_answers.VQ-1: Yes. groups-invitation-preview, groups-profile-update-propagation, groups-remove-member: 16/16 pass on a wiped relay (was 3 failed + 2 not run).
verification_answers.VQ-2: Yes. Accepts only contact-added-success / contact-already-exists-info AND a URL with id=<expected hex> and added=1|exists=1. add-page-error and unrelated navigation fail. Not separately e2e-tested for blocked/self/invalid (no negative test added).
verification_answers.VQ-3: Yes. Only app/tests/e2e/helpers/group-setup.ts changed; no production or per-spec edits.
verification_answers.VQ-4: Yes. groups-rename + groups-cancel-pending (first-seed path via inviteContactViaPicker) 14/14 pass; the first-add path in the 3 target specs also passes. First attempt of the regex omitted the trailing slash Next adds (/contacts/?id=) and broke first-add; corrected.
verification_answers.VQ-5: Yes. Doc comment now describes the exists=1 landing and states add-page-error is not success.
